title: note_v1 output
description: The only shape a drafting model may return. Mirrors DraftNote in session.v1: the pair is checked for drift by research/tests/test_prompt_schema.py, because a note the client cannot store is a failed draft.

problem.description: The symptom as the customer experienced it, not the cause.

steps.description: What was done, in order. Empty is valid when the session holds no usable evidence.

result.description: What is true now, stated so a colleague could verify it.

follow_ups.description: Only what is genuinely left open. Empty is a correct answer.

suggested_time_minutes.description: Active minutes, unrounded. The client applies the tenant's billing rounding (ST-066).

kb_reason.description: One sentence saying why, either way. Read by whoever decides to write the article.

confidence.description: high only when the technician said what they were doing or the frames show the change itself. A step with no transcript_refs is low.

frame_refs.description: Frame ids from the input, verbatim.

transcript_refs.description: Transcript segment ids from the input, verbatim.
